title: Pip and the Super-Duper Soapy Paws
moral: Washing our hands and brushing our teeth help us stay healthy and strong.
description: After a morning of puddle jumping, Pip, Tumble and Hazel are muddy from nose to tail, and Nana Hoot's blueberry muffins are waiting! Learn the five steps of hand washing and how often to brush your teeth in this funny, bubbly animated story about healthy habits, for kids aged 3 to 8.

narration.text: Guess what, friends? Last night it rained and rained. So this morning, Mud Puddle Meadow was full of big, brown puddles!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Puddle jumping! Super-duper!
Pip jumped. SPLOOSH! Tumble jumped. SPLOOOOSH! Then teeny Hazel jumped... splish! Three splashes!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Tee-hee-hee! We're all muddy!
Mud on their paws, mud on their tails, and a big mud blob right on the end of Tumble's trunk! HONK!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Snack time, little ones! Warm blueberry muffins!
ZIP! Pip zoomed to the table with his muddy paws. Then he wiped them on his tail. Swish, swish! Now his tail was muddy too!
Should Pip eat a muffin with muddy paws? What do you think?
Nooo! First, we wash our hands, or paws! Germs are teeny-tiny, too small to see.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Come along to the wash tub, everyone!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I can help, Hazel! Hold out your paws.
Tumble gently poured clean water over Hazel's paws. Trickle, trickle. Step four is RINSE! Bye-bye, bubbles!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: Tee-hee-hee! Thank you, friends! My paws are squeaky clean!

narration.text: That night, in Nana Hoot's cozy bathroom, it was tooth-brushing time!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: I've got my tooth-brushy-thingy!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Pip, that's my HAIRbrush! This little one is your toothbrush. Brush in little circles, top teeth and bottom teeth, front and back.
How many times a day should we brush our teeth?
Two times! In the morning and at night! Swish, swish... and Pip got a big, foamy toothpaste beard!
Let's remember! To wash our hands, first we WET, then we SOAP... what comes next?
SCRUB! Then rinse, and dry! Wet, soap, scrub, rinse, dry! You're so smart!
And how many times a day do we brush our teeth?
Two! In the morning and at night! Hooray!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Clean paws, shiny teeth, and the kindest friends. Goodnight, little ones!
